blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — As the state weather agency Pagasa has declared the presence of a “very strong” El Niño in the tropical Pacific, Manila Water Non-East Zone operating units Tanauan Water and Laguna Aquatech are intensifying water security measures across the South Luzon corridor to help ensure reliable water service and strengthen water security for the communities they serve. In Batangas, South Luzon Water, which provides water supply services for Tanauan City, has accelerated the implementation of its El Niño readiness program through strategic infrastructure investments, operational enhancements, and proactive supply management measures aimed at maintaining reliable water service despite prolonged dry […]...
